# solidping_channel (Resource)

A notification channel: webhook, email, Discord, Google Chat, Mattermost, ntfy, PagerDuty, Pushover, ...

~> **Slack channels cannot be managed with Terraform.** They are created by installing the SolidPing Slack app (an OAuth flow), and the API refuses to create one directly. Reference an existing one with the `solidping_channel` data source.

The type-specific settings go in `settings`, as a JSON object. Secrets go in `settings_sensitive`: the API stores them encrypted and never returns them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A webhook. SolidPing signs every delivery; custom headers go in `settings.headers`.
resource "solidping_channel" "ops_webhook" {
  type = "webhook"
  name = "Ops webhook"

  settings = jsonencode({
    url     = "https://hooks.acme.com/solidping"
    headers = { "X-Source" = "solidping" }
  })
}

# An ntfy topic, with its access token kept out of the readable settings.
resource "solidping_channel" "ntfy" {
  type       = "ntfy"
  name       = "ntfy alerts"
  is_default = true

  settings = jsonencode({
    server_url = "https://ntfy.acme.com"
    topic      = "solidping-alerts"
  })

  settings_sensitive = jsonencode({
    auth_token = var.ntfy_token
  })
}

variable "ntfy_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `type` (String) Channel type: `webhook`, `email`, `discord`, `googlechat`, `mattermost`, `ntfy`, `pagerduty`, `pushover`, ... Changing it replaces the channel.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether notifications are sent to this channel. Defaults to `true`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether new checks notify this channel by default.
- `settings` (String) Type-specific settings, as a JSON object: `jsonencode({ url = "https://acme.com/hook" })`. Only the keys written here are compared with the server.
- `settings_sensitive` (String, Sensitive) Secret settings, as a JSON object merged over `settings` when the channel is written. Never read back from the server. Removing a key clears the stored secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UID of the channel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A channel is imported with `org/uid`.
terraform import solidping_channel.ops_webhook acme/0190f3a2-7c1d-7e3b-9a55-2f4f8a1b6c7d
```
